name: Tiana's Buttermilk Beignets
whyItWorks: Airy refined white-flour pastry dusted with powdered sugar has virtually zero insoluble fiber and melts quickly like a warm glazed doughnut.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy warm with the powdered sugar and smooth chocolate espresso dipping sauce (skip the dipping sauce if avoiding trace coffee/caffeine). Best when fried grease doesn't bother your stomach.
watchOuts: Espresso in the chocolate dipping sauce
